name: Toyota Boshoku Corporation
quirks: Reports in JPY millions under IFRS. FY label = year ENDED 31 March (FY2026 = year to 2026-03-31). Reports half-yearly plus Q1/Q3 quarterlies. Material non-controlling interests (~24-26% of group profit; NCI equity JPY 43.8bn) so use profit attributable to owners of the parent. IFRS-16 lease principal repayments (JPY 42.8bn FY2026, in financing) must be deducted for owner FCF -- reported FCF overstates owner cash flow ~3.4x. Net CASH on borrowings. Negligible SBC.
